summary:
#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**  

- **[SensorKit Request] (SensorKit Review Team, Apple) – August 13, 2024, at 1:10 AM:**  
- Requested an updated copy of the SensorKit proposal due to issues with text boxes on the first page.  
- *Key quote:* "Can you send an updated copy of your SensorKit proposal? It seems that the text boxes on the first page of the document have been modified so we can't copy the content inside of them to view it."  

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Co-Investigator, The Happiness Research Institute) – August 26, 2024, at 19:26:**  
- Provided updated copies of the SensorKit proposal and pasted the content of the text boxes in the email.  
- *Key quote:* "Nonetheless, I re-saved 2 copies of the PDF using different methods (attached). If that still didn’t solve the issue, I pasted the content of the text boxes below."  

- **[SensorKit Request] (SensorKit Review Team, Apple) – August 27, 2024, at 9:56 AM:**  
- Acknowledged receipt of the updated proposal.  
- *Key quote:* "Thank you, this works!"  

- **[SensorKit Request] (SensorKit Review Team, Apple) – August 27, 2024, at 1:00 PM:**  
- Explained the two stages of entitlements (Development and Distribution) and requested additional documents.  
- *Key quote:* "We approve the development entitlement pending agreement to the addendum to the SensorKit Addendum."  

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Co-Investigator, The Happiness Research Institute) – August 29, 2024, at 8:32 AM:**  
- Noted missing data types in the Addendum and requested updates.  
- Provided IRB approval and consent documents for the Distribution entitlement.  
- *Key quote:* "Could you address the missing data types and update us on this?"  

- **[SensorKit Request] (SensorKit Review Team, Apple) – August 30, 2024, at 00:41:**  
- Clarified that the form doesn’t support newer data types but assured they would be included.  
- Provided an updated link for the collaborator agreement.  
- *Key quote:* "Right now the form doesn't support those 2 data types since they are newer, but please complete the Addendum form without them."  

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Co-Investigator, The Happiness Research Institute) – September 9, 2024, at 17:35:**  
- Confirmed signing of agreements and inquired about outstanding items.  
- *Key quote:* "We’ve signed both those agreements from our end – is there anything else outstanding at this point?"  

- **[SensorKit Request] (SensorKit Review Team, Apple) – October 3, 2024, at 8:59 AM:**  
- Requested the bundle ID for the application to grant the development entitlement.  
- *Key quote:* "Can you please provide the bundle ID for your application?"  

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Co-Investigator, The Happiness Research Institute) – October 3, 2024, at 3:13 PM:**  
- Provided the bundle ID: com.avicenna.hri3805.  
- *Key quote:* "The identifier is com.avicenna.hri3805"  

- **[SensorKit Request] (SensorKit Review Team, Apple) – October 4, 2024, at 00:53:**  
- Confirmed entitlement to access SensorKit data streams and provided usage overview.  
- *Key quote:* "Your app has just been entitled to access the following SensorKit data streams for your study."  

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Co-Investigator, The Happiness Research Institute) – October 11, 2024, at 15:40:**  
- Followed up on the status of the distribution entitlement.  
- *Key quote:* "Is anything else needed? We have signed the collaborator agreement & sent the requested ethics approval letter and consent form."  

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Co-Investigator, The Happiness Research Institute) – October 28, 2024, at 10:45:**  
- Circled back to check on the status of the request.  
- *Key quote:* "Have you heard anything, or do you have any routes for us to find out what’s happening with this approval request?"  

#### **2. Timeline**  
- **[August 13, 2024]:** SensorKit Request asks for an updated proposal.  
- **[August 26, 2024]:** Camilla provides updated proposal and text box content.  
- **[August 27, 2024]:** SensorKit acknowledges receipt and explains entitlement process.  
- **[August 29, 2024]:** Camilla notes missing data types in Addendum.  
- **[September 9, 2024]:** Camilla confirms signing of agreements.  
- **[October 3, 2024]:** Camilla provides bundle ID.  
- **[October 4, 2024]:** SensorKit confirms entitlement to data streams.  
- **[October 11, 2024]:** Camilla follows up on distribution entitlement.  

#### **3. Key Events/Issues**  
- **Issue 1:** Missing data types in Addendum (Heart Rate, Wrist Temperature).  
- **Feedback Submission:** Camilla provided IRB approval and consent documents.  
- **Access/Login Issues:** SensorKit confirmed entitlement but distribution entitlement still pending.  

#### **4. Action Items**  
- **Pending:**  
- Approval of distribution entitlement (assigned to SensorKit Review Team).  
- **Completed:**  
- Submission of bundle ID (completed by Camilla).  
- Signing of Addendum and collaborator agreement (completed by Camilla).  

#### **5. Technical Details**  
- **Account/Login Info:** Bundle ID: com.avicenna.hri3805.  
- **Study ID/Project Code:** App ID #6503913823.  

#### **6. Next Steps**  
- **Action 1:** SensorKit Review Team to approve distribution entitlement.  
- **Action 2:** Camilla to follow up if no response is received.
